scope: edge BVH reproducible launch-count performance gate

measurement_contract.timing_and_memory: at least five timed samples with raw values, median, and p95
components: Dr.Jit kernels with OptiX classified as a subset
measurement_contract.total: sum of mutually exclusive launch components; Dr.Jit OptiX classification is not double-counted

gate.legacy_baseline: rejected by default; explicit compatibility flag skips only launch comparisons and emits warnings

lightweight_acceptance.native_benchmark: deferred until freshly built binaries are available
